edits.after: Your rockets reach 1325 and the grenade 970 against her 950 Inner Flame, and she has no dash — this is the stage you tax her off the wave.

edits.before: This is your window. With three banked turret charges and the CH-3X Lightning Grenade you turn the lane into a tax booth — bait her E shield, land the center-stun, then fan W-rockets so the nest plus the grenade convert one stun into a chunk she can't peel through. At 6 her only real answer is the Mantra-empowered RQ root: it's a single-target skillshot, so body-block it with a turret or sidestep it and she has nothing left. Whiff it and she's just farming from max range while your beams zone her off CS.
edits.after: This is your window. With three banked turret charges and the grenade on a flat 11s you turn the lane into a tax booth — bait her Inspire shield, land the direct-hit stun, then fan rockets so the nest converts one stun into a chunk she can't peel through. Her lockdown is Focused Resolve into Mantra-W: 675 range, flat 12s, and the Mantra version heals her mid-root, so break the tether by stepping out or behind a turret and buy Oblivion Orb before you try to grind her down. Mantra itself is nothing new at 6 — she has had it since level 1.

notes: Two ability-interaction errors of the calibration type. First, the page attributed Karma's root to 'Mantra-empowered RQ'; the root is Focused Resolve (W), and Mantra-Q is a delayed cataclysm with no CC — a player dodging the wrong spell gets rooted anyway. Second, the page treated Mantra as a level-6 arrival; Riot's own text says it is available at level 1 without a skill point. Row 3 flipped to Heimerdinger in a matched pair, per the packet chart and the mirror. I left phases[3].rating alone: the Heimerdinger-favoured rows on this page all sit at 5/10 while the Skill rows sit at 6/10, so the rating scale here does not track the side field and I could not tell which convention to follow — flagged in questionsForUser.
